levels.surface: عبد الله بن مسلمة بن قعنب

notes: Two branches split at «ح»; the second writes «قرأت على مالك» itself, and the tail «عن ابن شهاب» is written once.
«حمزة، وسالم، ابنى عبد الله بن عمر»: the nasab describes both men and is not a link; names are left as written.
«عبد الله بن عمر» occurrence 2 is the Companion; occurrence 1 is the father in the apposition.
